## What's new

- AI model settings are rebuilt on the DeepSeek Harness "Settings → Models" shape. Providers are row cards showing display name, credential status, and which connection is in use; a row expands into an inline editor card with the API key field and a collapsed "Custom settings" section for display name, API endpoint, protocol, and model catalogue.
- Add a provider through a segmented card — third-party compatible API / custom model API / subscription sign-in — and switch segments without losing what you typed. Subscription sign-in is the existing ChatGPT flow, unchanged.
- Each model is its own editable row: Model ID, display name, context window and max output tokens (K/M suffixes such as 256K or 1M are accepted), and text/image input types. Rows can be moved up or down, removed, added by hand, or reset with "Restore default models".
- "Get available models" probes the provider and opens a "Select models" dialog where the ticks define the model list; "Update list" adopts exactly what is ticked. An empty catalogue still allows sending IDs outside the list.
- Turn on reasoning tiers per model and map each tier (off through max) to the provider's API parameter value. Tiers are injected per protocol on requests: reasoning_effort for OpenAI protocols, thinking.budget_tokens for Anthropic Messages when the value is a plain number.

## Notes

- No provider catalogue ships with the app (product red line): you fill in the endpoint, protocol, and models yourself, or probe them with "Get available models". Nothing is prefilled from a vendor template.
- API keys stay write-only and are stored only in the system keychain; the temporary key field is cleared on close, cancel, and save. Course files never contain credentials.
- Reasoning parameters are injected only for models whose reasoning switch is on. When a request names no tier, the model's strongest configured thinking tier is used — there is no per-request tier picker yet — and the execution record shows the tier actually used ("no tier selected, using strongest tier ...").
- On Anthropic Messages, a tier whose API parameter value is not a plain number skips the thinking parameter and surfaces a readable warning instead of failing the request.
- This cut also merges the v3.0.0 release line into main (merge `1845af0`). That is repository state, not a new user-facing capability; everything from v3.0.0 shipped in v3.0.0.
- Automated gates passed on the frozen source: `deno task check`, `deno task test` (768 passed / 0 failed), and Rust `cargo test --lib ai_` (39 passed / 0 failed).
